hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *drizzle/[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]_*.sql) if [ -f "$f" ]; then printf 'Blocked: %s is a committed Drizzle migration. CI enforces migration-hash lineage, so editing an applied migration breaks the build. Edit src/lib/private-db/schema.ts and run: npm run db:generate\n' "$f" >&2; exit 2; fi;; esac; exit 0
f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx) out=$(npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1); if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then printf '%s\n' "$out" | head -60 >&2; exit 2; fi;; esac; exit 0
